title: Boece, Book II, Prosa 1 (Fortune & Governance)
author: Geoffrey Chaucer
clauses: After this she stynte a litel, and whan she haddeygadred by atempre stille myn attencioun, she seyde thus.
If I have understonden and knowen outrely the causes and the habyt of thy maladye, thow languyssest and art defeted for desir and talent of thy rather fortune.
Thow wenest that fortune be chaunged ayens thee; but thow wenest wrong, yif thou that wene: alwey tho ben hir maneres.
She hath rather kept as to the-ward hir propre stablenesse in the chaungynge of hirself.
